title: The Man Behind the Sound: Demystifying Audio Private Attribute Profiling via Multimodal Large Language Model Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of incorrect inferences for social stratum and income levels, revealing a strong skew (over 90% of errors) toward higher levels.
Evaluating the distribution of inferred accents from audio data, observing a concentration on a few specific accents (e.g., American, Canadian, British) with very low accuracy for others.
Observing skewed distributions and evident biases in the models' inferences of the age attribute from audio data.
